identity: Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū
frame_indexing: Zero-based source decoded frame. End frames exclusive. Source PTS = frame * 1001 / 30000.
accuracy: Contacts denote first visible intersection/impact, not hidden engine damage ticks. Native neighborhoods resolve listed events to source frames; other envelope transitions sampled every two source frames have up to one-frame uncertainty. Coin mappings are hypotheses without HUD.
scale: H = standing caster body height in the SAME shot. Distances are screen-plane estimates; not inferred from effect length.
color_note: Hex colors are visual palette approximations, not calibrated pixel measurements.
sheet_note: overview sheets are 6 fps; detail sheets select even source frames (~14.985 fps). detail f-label is SAMPLE index, not source frame; use timestamp. Native sheets label actual SRC frame; windows may be discontinuous.

weapon.type: Long narrow curved single-edged sword; katana/nodachi-like silhouette, with separate dark scabbard

weapon.measurement_note: Screen-space estimates from chibi sprite; camera scaling and foreshortening preclude exact world dimensions.

Two rapid changes of side, each ~2–3 H.
Final low sweep left; crouched recovery, red impressions and dust persist to cut.

Fresh vertical cross and blade pass across target
Further blue cross as red-afterimage return pass begins

Contact presentation 4; red silhouette and white smear at caster.
Arcs and dust vanish; crouched hold, cut to different arena.
